regime_context: The detector shows a market where cross-sectional momentum is a weak focus lens (rank-IC ~0) and the only validated edge is vol/drawdown control via the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps true). Leadership is split between 'Memory, HBM & Storage' (rank 1, but ineligible and breadth 0.0) and the eligible, crowded 'US Energy Complex' (headline theme, eligibility true, durability 0.69, breadth 0.955), with rotation display-only and not directional. Given a modest 61% hit rate but only 44% directional accuracy over 108 graded calls, conviction should default low and any lean must be a humble conditional.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the 'US Energy Complex' leadership CONFIRMS its handoff by sustaining breadth above 0.9 AND durability_bar above 0.65 through the next 10 trading days; if energy's crowding_z keeps climbing past 1.5 while breadth falls below 0.8, the watch retires as a crowded fade, not a trend. This is a watch, not a call.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: The strongest ELIGIBLE trend is US Energy Complex: absolute-trend gate passes (eligible true), durability_bar is high at 0.69, and breadth is exceptional at 0.955 — the theme is cohesively participating rather than being carried by one name. The rank-2 momentum score and headline status reflect where flow/attention are concentrating, but per the guardrails this is a focus lens, not a return forecast. A lean is warranted only because the one validated edge — the trend gate — is satisfied and breadth confirms participation, not because energy leads.
theses.dissent: The crowding flag (crowding_z=1.03, crowded=true) marks this as a sizing-down caution, not a conviction source; energy leadership can reverse fast on an oil-demand repricing, and the equal-weight energy proxy shows similar scores but the theme may simply be a mean-reverting bounce at the top of its range (hurst_tag=mixed).

falsifier.text: XLE closes below its 50-day average by end of the 20-day check window

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the highest-durability ELIGIBLE theme in the list (durability_bar=0.79) with strong breadth (0.889) and a trend hurst tag. The trend gate is satisfied. This is a defensive, vol-aware lean consistent with the only validated edge in the detector — trend persistence — even though the rank-4 score itself is not alpha. Crowding is high (crowding_z=1.68) so this is a size-down caution, not a high-conviction endorsement.
theses.dissent: PPH is heavily rate-sensitive and sitting at extreme crowding (z=1.68); if long-duration defensives unwind on a hawkish repricing, a crowded, high-durability theme can gap down precisely because everyone is already in it.

falsifier.text: PPH lags SPY by more than 5% over the 20-day window

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM shows the highest raw momentum score (rank 1, score 2.305) but is NOT eligible (absolute-trend gate fails) and has breadth=0.0 — the entire theme is being carried by a single name with no participation. Per the guardrails, the trend gate is the only validated risk-control edge, and this theme fails it. This is a display-only leadership flag, not a tradeable lean; avoiding it until the gate re-arms is the disciplined read.
evidence: rank 1 is momentum/attention only, not alpha
theses.dissent: The single-name HBM story could keep grinding higher on a durable AI-capex order cycle, and failure of the gate simply means no drawdown protection if it reverses — avoiding it may leave upside on the table, though that upside comes with precisely the tail the gate is designed to avoid.

falsifier.text: SMH re-arms eligible and breadth widens above 0.5 over the 20-day window
